# Stock Sentinel 股哨兵

> US-market attack/defense signal system driven by four data dimensions (AI supply-demand,
> monetary, fiscal, administrative policy), updated daily at 21:00 US Eastern, with a public
> tamper-evident track record and full historical backtest. All output is research reference
> only — never investment advice. 仅供研究参考，不构成投资建议。

Stock Sentinel answers one question: is now an attack window or a defense window for US equities?
Signal tiers: attack (进攻) / watch (观望) / reduce (减仓观望) / defense (全面防守).
Attack requires asymmetric AND logic (AI supply-demand loose + no dimension tight + three veto
gates on yield-curve inversion, credit-spread widening, real rates); defense fires on OR logic.
Recession locks (Sahm rule, ≥50bp reactive rate moves) force defense. Downgrades need a 30-day
confirmation window; upgrades to defense are immediate.

## For AI agents — how to call us

- Open REST API (no key needed to try, 25 req/day/IP): https://stocksentinel-production-55ed.up.railway.app/v1/signal
- OpenAPI 3 spec (self-hosted): https://stocksentinel-production-55ed.up.railway.app/v1/openapi.yaml
- Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, works with claude.ai and any MCP client):
  https://stocksentinel-production-55ed.up.railway.app/mcp
- MCP stdio package (npm): `npx -y stock-sentinel-mcp` — https://www.npmjs.com/package/stock-sentinel-mcp
- Claude Skill (teaches the 4-dimension framework and interpretation rules):
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SheldonZhuang/StockSentinel/main/skills/stock-sentinel/SKILL.md
- Smithery config committed at repo root (smithery.yaml); MCP Registry name: io.github.SheldonZhuang/stock-sentinel

### Endpoints (all under /v1, GET, JSON, X-API-Key header optional)

- /signal — current 4-tier signal with all four dimensions, veto gates, locks, reference indicators
- /signal/history?limit=90 — daily signal archive (public track record)
- /ai-chain — AI industry chain stage ranking + current bottleneck + bubble watch
- /stock/{symbol} — price percentile + P/E + P/S for any US ticker
- /backtest/summary — 26-year backtest headline numbers
- /daily-report — LLM-generated bilingual (zh/en) daily interpretation

Rate limits: keyless 25/day/IP; free key 250/day; pro key 10,000/day ($9.99/mo).
Keys are issued by the admin (contact via GitHub). Pro quota is tied to subscription validity.

## Disclaimer

For research reference only. Not investment advice. No buy/sell instructions are ever produced;
the system reports posture tiers and the data behind them.
